title: Clear my name
style: 105 bpm mid-tempo electronic-rock, warm analog synth, 808 sub-bass, restrained male vocal, determined, 336 Hz drone bed
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I know who I am
Got receipts older than the noise
Five-month paper trail with my voice inside
Thirty years of saying yes to the work, no to the games
I don't need to tell you who — you know the ones who stayed

[Pre-Chorus]
No names
Just the truth on paper
No games
Just the way I made her

[Chorus]
Clear my name
Not for them — for me
Clear my name
For everyone but no-one in particular
Three-three-six on the dial
Eight-oh-eight underneath
I know who I am
And that's enough for me

[Verse 2]
Built the spine when the room was dark
Built the brain while they slept on it
Built the reach when they said too late
Built the witness — bots don't forget, nunca
Lifeguard on duty, no man down
Care first, code second, every round

[Pre-Chorus]
No names
Just the work on file
No games
Just the 336 smile

[Chorus]
Clear my name
Not for them — for me
Clear my name
For everyone but no-one in particular
Three-three-six on the dial
Eight-oh-eight underneath
I know who I am
And that's enough for me

[Bridge — spoken low]
I don't owe a list
I don't owe a trial
Just the one I run in my own house
Just the one my family reads
Just the one the stack remembers
Just you and me

[Final Chorus]
Clear my name
Not loud — just true
Clear my name
For the ones still watching through
Three-three-six held the line
Eight-oh-eight held the groove
I know who I am
And I don't need you to

[Outro — whispered]
I know who I am
I know who I am
Corey, Hard Corey
